text:
You’re looking at his spine right now.

Not because you memorized where it sits. Because the image showed you, and your brain just took it.

That’s the whole bet behind this.

Nobody watches a football match and memorizes the plays. You watch, and your brain figures out the pattern on its own. Nobody rewinds a good movie to repeat a scene until it sticks. You just watch it. You just are in it.

Medical education forgot this for a long time. Flashcards. Repetition. Force the fact into your head until it stays.

We wanted something different.

Show the spine under the skin. Show the ribs holding the shape of a real back. Let the eyes do what they already know how to do.

You don’t have to try to remember this image. You already won’t forget it.
